interfaces.name: prepare(gates, checkedHoldingPoints)
interfaces.meaning: Build an isolated reservation table from original gate IDs and prevalidated holding points; do not modify geometry.

interfaces.name: request(unitId, gateId, fromLane, toLane, now)
interfaces.meaning: Create monotonically ordered FIFO ticket; same request is idempotent.

interfaces.name: tick(now, observedUnits)
interfaces.meaning: Return movement intents and status transitions. All intents are executed using real Commands/Path/Workers.

interfaces.name: cancel(ticket, reason)
interfaces.meaning: Withdraw waiting ticket immediately; an active disk inside the aperture retains exclusion until safe egress or a declared blocked result.

interfaces.name: release()
interfaces.meaning: Detach all wrappers, clear reservations; no persistence or old-save migration.

invariants: No waiting center or cell disk intersects the gate exclusion disk (gate.radius plus actual unit radius plus sweep reserve).
One crossing reservation at a time for the initial prototype; no direction change before the current disk clears the exclusion zone.
Only the next eligible FIFO ticket is admitted; discarded, dead or timed-out tickets remain in the log with a reason.
A blocked active unit cannot be made invisible or released while physically obstructing the aperture.
Waiting has an explicit deadline and returns timed_out if it cannot be serviced; timeout is a failed traversal, not success.
No teleport, geometry widening, collision-radius reduction, food/air/urine aperture or arbitrary graph edge.
Pre-existing cells inside the gate protection zone require a separate evacuation protocol before ordinary queue admission.
requiredTests: Same frozen six-cell starts and goals, comparing unreserved and reserved traces.
Every arrival crosses both directions and returns, all three real radii retained.
No overlapping disks, wall penetration or undeclared lane transition.
FIFO admission ordering and measured maximum wait, with non-completion retained.
Cancellation, death, active blocker timeout and reservation cleanup.
No gate-front waiting point occupies another unit or lies on forbidden anatomy.
No production import or save-state changes.
currentLimitations: Interface design only; no traffic adapter or traffic acceptance claimed.
Crowd baseline report must finish before selecting a specific intervention.
Safe holding positions for frozen starts have not been measured; several starts may lie inside aperture protection zones.
